title: VTC Booking — Bookings — List — payload
description: List the caller's own bookings, or — for a host — the bookings on their pages. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

role.description: `booker`: the caller's own bookings. `host`: bookings on the caller's pages.

from.description: Only bookings ending at or after this.

cursor.description: An opaque continuation token from a previous response's `nextCursor`, bound to the caller and the filters; a responder MUST NOT accept a cursor it did not issue.

limit.description: The most items to return, at most 100; the responder chooses a default (50) and MAY return fewer.

Response.title: VTC Booking — Bookings — List — response payload
Response.description: The success response to a vtc/booking/bookings/list/0.1 request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/vtc/booking/bookings/list/0.1#response.

nextCursor.description: Present when more items follow: pass it as `cursor` to continue.
